officialSources.verified: android build generates APK/AAB; --debug, --apk, --target x86_64, --ci and --config are supported. --open explicitly opens Android Studio. Build and run/dev are distinct commands.
Android build requires SDK, JDK, NDK_HOME and installed Rust Android targets. These environment variables are set only within the audit build process.
ANDROID_USER_HOME and ANDROID_AVD_HOME isolate preferences and AVD files. Deprecated ANDROID_SDK_HOME is omitted to avoid a preferences-path conflict in installed cmdline-tools 12.
create avd -n -k -p creates a new AVD at an explicit path; --force would overwrite and is never used here. The installed avdmanager remains usable although current documentation marks it deprecated.
AVDs may share the SDK read-only system image; writable user-data belongs to each distinct AVD. -list-avds lists definitions without booting a device.

Real SAF acceptance must use an allowed subtree such as Documents/Catstep QA, not internal-storage or Download root, Android/data, or Android/obb, which are restricted on Android 11+. Persisted URI grants and provider capabilities need actual runtime checks.

The pinned project's Gradle 8.13 distribution was downloaded from official gradle/gradle-distributions GitHub release v8.13.0 and matched official services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.13-bin.zip.sha256 exactly. See gradle-download-verification.json.
